recipe.preconstruct: class Row extends fgui.GLabel { onConstruct() { this.data = { registered: true }; } } fgui.UIObjectFactory.setExtension('ui://example1row', Row);

setup.code: const list = ctx.root.getChild('list'); list.itemRenderer = (index, cell) => cell.text = cell.data.registered ? 'Extended row' : 'Plain row'; list.numItems = 1;
